history.summary: Freehold 1BR at Le Regal, a small D14 development 770m from Aljunied MRT, asking $770k ($1,118 PSF). Entry quantum is low and PSF sits well below the $1,500 URA median, but it's a boutique series with only 23 txns.
history.rating_rationale: $770k entry and freehold tenure are attractive, and $1,118 PSF is a ~25% discount to the $1,500 median. But the 689 sqft '1BR' is oversized for one bedroom (possible misclassification / inefficient layout), the 7.5%/yr URA rate rests on just 23 txns, and Le Regal is a small development — limiting liquidity. Paya Lebar Central catalyst is genuine and supports the area.

history.summary: The cleanest of the five: $1,117.56psf is at the low end of the verified $1,103-$1,500 recent-resale range (avg ~$1,304), and unlike its peers it has a REAL size-cohort (psf_cohort_txns=11) sitting only +6.7% above its own band. Genuine, defensible value plus a strong ~6% rental yield.
history.rating_rationale: Le Regal is an 88-unit freehold (2015) on Geylang Road, 820m to Aljunied MRT. Recent resales average ~$1,304 psf (12-mo range $1,103-$1,500; current asks $1,110-$1,781). This listing's $1,117.56 psf is near the floor of the actual transacted range - a real discount to the average, and critically it is the ONLY dossier here with a credible size-cohort: psf_cohort_txns=11 and psf_premium_vs_cohort only +6.7%, meaning the 689sqft/sub-$800k entry is fairly priced (slightly above) within its own size band, not a thin-data illusion. The -41.4% age-adjusted premium is corroborated by genuine cheap-vs-district evidence. Portal-quoted rental yield ~6.1% is strong. D14/OCR-adjacent carries the favorable v3.4 forward region prior (~+4%). Caveats: it is a mixed-use block (88 residential units above 48 commercial shops, street-facing => noise, and a mixed-use building can carry slightly thinner financing/exit). On balance the value + verified cohort + yield justify a Buy at medium confidence; the model explains <10% of forward variance so I withhold high.
red_flags: Mixed commercial/residential development - units sit above 48 shops, street-facing on Geylang Road (noise; some lenders cap LTV on mixed-use)
